notes: No news, research or government report found that names Mastercard Foundation or Novo Holdings as 501(c)(4) filers, or that measures foreign groups' share of 501(c)(4) assets. The only hits naming the entities are database profiles (ProPublica, Charity Navigator) that confirm the 501(c)(4) designation and asset figures matching the lead ($50.32B, $36.17B). Pattern coverage found is only tax-practitioner explanation of why foreign orgs claim 501(c) status (withholding exemption). Coverage of foreign money in 501(c)(4)s (e.g., Wyss/Berger Action Fund) is about political donations, a different scheme, and was not recorded. No coverage dated after 2026-06-30 found. The Mastercard Foundation's US Form 990 filings go back at least to 2011 (Foundation Center 990 archive), so the status itself is long-standing and public.
